candidates.inlineText: Welcome to London, Keenan Evans! 🦁 The London Lions are delighted to announce the signing of American point guard Keenan Evans on a season-long loan from Žalgiris Kaunas ahead of the 2026-27 season. Evans has agreed a deal with Žalgiris and will spend the coming season in London, reuniting with a coaching group he knows well. He arrives with an impressive résumé, having established himself as one of Europe’s premier guards through spells with Žalgiris Kaunas, Maccabi Tel Aviv and, most recently, Greek giants Olympiacos. A proven leader and elite playmaker, the 6'3" guard has performed at the very highest level of European basketball. During the 2023-24 EuroLeague season with Žalgiris, Evans played all 34 regular season games and averaged 17.3 points and 3.9 assists, posting an 18.3 performance index rating at an MVP-calibre level and earning recognition as one of the competition’s most dynamic offensive talents. Evans moved to Olympiacos in the summer of 2024, but the past two seasons have been disrupted by injury, limiting his time on the court. Now, with his rehabilitation reported to be ahead of schedule and fully focused on the next chapter of his career, he arrives in London
